Jonas "Lekr0" Olofsson (born July 2, 1993) is a Swedish professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former professional Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player.

  • 2015-02-13 | Lekr0 Take The Stage by ShAdOw of Team Decerto

  • 2017-12-15 | Lekr0: "Maybe if we aimed higher, we would've played better [at EPL]" by Professeur of HLTV at Esports Championship Series Season 4 - Finals
  • 2018-01-21 | Lekr0: "Played only CS at our bootcamp, no other games" by Striker of HLTV at ELEAGUE Major Boston 2018

  • 2018-07-22 | Lekr0: "In practice, I usually frag really well, but it's not the same when I'm calling on LAN" by Striker of HLTV at Europe Minor Championship - London 2018
